caption: The drawing depicts a small, decorative bag with a blue drawstring and a scalloped blue top section. The main body of the bag features a colorful, intricate beaded design. In the central scene, there are two human figures: one seated under a green tree, dressed in blue and pink, and another standing beside them in a yellow garment, holding what appears to be a basket. The background includes a green landscape with patches of brown, additional trees, and two white sheep on the right near a white fence or structure. The lower section of the bag is bordered with a pattern of blue and red flowers, green leaves, and a geometric design in brown, yellow, and blue tones. The overall color palette includes shades of green, blue, red, yellow, brown, white, and pink, creating a detailed composition that blends human figures, animals, plants, and geometric motifs.
title: Beaded Bag
